## E0. Leads from Jonathan (unverified)

**Source.** Oral statements by Jonathan on 18 Oct 2026. He holds no documents. Each lead is logged as he stated it.

- None is a record fact.
- None changes any analysis above until documents arrive.
- Gathering records for these leads is a CoS decision. Nothing is to be requested in a way that touches 26-360 without Barandon.

**L1. "Efren Balane has helped Salvador transfer properties for years."**

- *Records needed:*
  - deeds of sale, SPAs and acknowledgments where Efren M. Balane signs as party, witness or representative for Salvador de la Fuente, or for Cesar M. de la Fuente;
  - the RD Camarines Norte entries for those instruments;
  - the notarial register entries (OCC Daet notarial section) for the same instruments;
  - Assessor transfer records naming Efren.
- *Record so far:* Efren's name appears on two Def. Exh. 5 receipts as payor (2003, 2005; PB §2). There is nothing showing him acting for Salvador.
- *Status:* unverified. No effect on Part D (civil only) until documents arrive.

**L2. "Atty. Ramos oversaw three spurious transfers for the family."**

- *Records needed:* for each of the three transfers,
  - the title (TCT before and after);
  - the deed;
  - the notarial register entry (notary, Doc./Page/Book/Series);
  - any document showing Ramos's role (counsel, notary, witness, filer).
- *Interaction:* this lead touches the excluded Ramos conflict trace. **Log the lead only. Do not merge it with that trace, and do not research it in this file.**
- *Record so far:* the 26-360 record shows Ramos only as defense counsel from Mar 2026 (ORD pp.2–3) and as attesting counsel on the JAs (JA-E p.6; JA-P p.6; JA-G p.14).
- *Status:* unverified. The word "spurious" is Jonathan's characterization, not a finding. The CPRA Canon II §13 caution in Part B applies to any use.

**L3. "The referral (ARTA 1378 → CSC Region V) happened because they broke the law."**

- *Records needed:*
  - the ARTA 1378 resolution or referral and its stated grounds;
  - the CSC Region V docket and any action taken.
  - The 1378 BOT owns both.
- *Record so far:* none in 26-360.
- *Status:* unverified. A referral is not a finding of violation. Until the CSC acts, the referral shows only that a referral was made [INFERRED from the nature of a referral].
- *Separation:* the ARTA/CSC track stays separate (see the header note). This annex does not adopt its conclusions.

**Effect on verdicts.** The verdicts in Part E are kept as they are. They rest on the 26-360 record only and may change when documents for L1–L3 arrive and are verified.
